aboutUs.title: About us
aboutUs.description: We are a self-service laundry where you don't need to book an appointment! We warmly welcome you to our small, family-run laundry in the heart of the city center. Bring your laundry and the washing can begin! We hope you will like this little place that we have created with love and care. Thank you for your trust!

1.question: Where can I find Perla Laundry?
1.answer: The laundry is located on the ground floor of Porta Pátria, easily accessible for local residents.

2.question: Is there parking lot available nearby?
2.answer: Yes, there is a large paid parking lot available right next to the laundry.

3.question: What are the opening hours?
3.answer: Every day from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Machines can be started until 9:00 PM at the latest.

4.question: How does the laundry work?
4.answer: Perla Laundry operates in a self-service system. The machines can be started through a touchscreen payment interface, no registration or app is needed.

5.question: How long does each cycle take and what temperature does it use?
5.answer: It depends on the temperature of the cycle. Washing in cold water takes up 35 minutes, 40 °C 39 minutes, 60 °C 43 minutes, 75 °C 58 minutes and 90 °C takes 73 minutes. There are two drying cycles, 40 and 50 minutes.

6.question: How much does a washing or drying cost?
6.answer: For 10 kg capacity machines, the cost is 2,000 HUF, and for 14 kg capacity machines, it is 2,300 HUF for both washing and drying.

7.question: Do I need to bring my own detergent?
7.answer: No, you don't need to. The machines automatically dispense premium quality detergent, so you don't have to worry about that.

8.question: What machines are available?
8.answer: There are 2 washing machines with 10 kg capacity, 1 washing machine with 14 kg capacity, 2 dryers with 10 kg capacity, and 1 dryer with 14 kg capacity available.

9.question: What payment options are available?
9.answer: The payment interface supports both card or cash payments.

10.question: Is there a staff on-site?
10.answer: Perla Laundry is self-service, and there is no staff on-site. For questions or issues, a phone customer service is available.

tips.1: When you finish washing, please leave the washing machine door open!
tips.2: Before loading, always check that the drum is completely empty.
tips.3: Carefully inspect the clothes to ensure there are no foreign objects (e.g. stones, coins, keys).
tips.4: Always follow the care instructions found on the garment labels.
tips.5: Please avoid pressing buttons unnecessarily, and do not add detergent after the cycle has started.
tips.6: Shake out clothes before loading to help remove dust and dirt.
tips.7: Once the cycle has completed, remove the clothes promptly
tips.8: Do not overload the machine - make sure the clothes have enough space to move freely.

use.1: Carefully check laundry items, empty all pockets, close zippers, fasten all clips!
use.2: Only wash regular clothing and other general household textiles (e.g., towels, bedsheets, etc.) - see prohibited items below!
use.3: Do not put any metal objects, rigid plastic, or waterproofed items (e.g., tents, tarpaulins) into the machine.
use.4: Do not insert rubber, sponge-like material, painted fabrics, or items treated with solvent or petrol-based thinner!
use.5: Do not put clothes contaminated with flammable, combustible, or explosive substances into the machine!
use.6: The laundry is not a playground. Do not allow children to climb into or play with it.
use.7: Once the cycle has started, do not press any buttons or attempt to open the door until the cycle ends.
use.8: The washing cycle cannot be stopped once started.

notice.1: Do not place carpets, rubber-backed textiles, items covered in pet hair, or filled textiles with damaged covers (e.g., blankets, pillows, jackets) into the machines!
notice.2: For effective washing and drying, DO NOT overload the machines - fill only up to the top third of the drum
